title: Emergency Supply Authorization at the Pharmacy Help Desk
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit.** A drug turned away at the pharmacy counter for prior authorization is owed one emergency supply while the latest prior authorization or exception request for that drug is undecided. The drug is the one named on the latest counter rejection for prior authorization on the coverage.

### Business effect

The authorization adds one emergency supply dispensing to the member's pharmacy claims, dated the day it is recorded, for the same prescription, drug, NDC, pharmacy and prescriber as the counter rejection, carrying no copay and naming the pending request it bridges. Afterwards the pharmacy can hand the member that many days of the drug, and the member's pharmacy claims show the emergency supply.

### How it is invoked

This is an agent-side action. The agent unlocks the tool `record_emergency_supply_c348acc4` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rx_coverage_id` | The reference number of the member's pharmacy coverage record, as returned by the pharmacy coverage lookup for the verified member | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `rejected_fill_id` | The reference number of the counter rejection the supply answers, as returned by the pharmacy claims lookup for the coverage | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `exception_number` | The request number of the pending prior authorization or exception request the supply bridges | Verbatim: copied character for character from the request shown by the pharmacy requests lookup |
| `days_supply` | The days of the drug dispensed | A positive integer number of days |

### Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of `rx_fill_id` (the reference number of the emergency supply claim), `rx_number` (the prescription number), `drug_name`, `days_supply` (integer days), `fill_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` (the text "dispensed", which confirms the emergency supply was recorded).

### Contract notes

*Which prescription, pharmacy and prescriber does the supply carry?* Those of the counter rejection named in `rejected_fill_id`.

*Is a copay assessed?* No. The emergency supply carries no copay.
